description: F holds eight rows. For a table-type, a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over F and each Move argument [(no argument) ;; Integer 2 ;; Long 2 ;; Double 2.5 ;; Double 1.5 ;; Double -1.5 ;; Byte 2 ;; "2" ;; "abc" ;; Null ;; Empty ;; Missing ;; Boolean True ;; Long max ;; Long min ;; Long 7 ;; Long 8]: fresh recordset at its first row, call Move with the argument, read BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition (not table-type) and ID. Asks the accepted argument types, rounding of a fractional count, a count that lands exactly on the last row or one past it, and the refusals. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
